data.summary: The building surveyor firm Musterhausen Bausachverständige GbR replies to your enquiry about basement moisture, enclosing a flat-rate offer, and asks you to confirm by their deadline whether they should carry out the survey.
data.explanation: This is a reply to your own request for a building survey about dampness in your basement. The firm has sent a fixed-price offer (enclosed) and is waiting for your decision on whether to go ahead. You need to let them know, by the deadline the app shows (counted in working days, where Saturdays count but Sundays and public holidays do not), whether they should perform the on-site inspection and write the report. The letter does not say what happens if you miss this date, but it is best to reply promptly so the offer stays valid and the survey can be scheduled.

key_facts.label: Reply deadline
key_facts.quote:
Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir
das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn-
und Feiertage.
